title: Shelter among tentacles
hook: A reef animal can use another living structure as cover.

knows: Different fish can have different structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The second view places a stylized clownfish among an anemone’s tentacles. Clownfishes can shelter in association with sea anemones; the details and benefits of an association vary, and this drawing does not explain the full physiology of contact.

misconception: The first imagined explanation must apply to this fish.
objective: In this illustrated association, where does the clownfish find shelter?
